descriptions.d27h_clock_display_update_800a1d4c: Clock display update: converts the round time at +68 to minutes and seconds in the text at +56, reads the display mode into +152, then for the text at +52 blanks it in mode 0, shows retreat time in mode 1, or in mode 2 shows turn time with a flashing colour below 6 seconds, calling 0x800a2e78 when the second changes and posting cached messages at 5 and 15 seconds; finally writes the colours and digits and runs 0x800a30bc and 0x800a34f4. Returns 0.
